description: Source code for an audio recording utility that captures audio and writes it as a WAV file, including header setup and file I/O operations.

methods.name: record_file
methods.description: Records audio data from PCM device and writes to file descriptor.

methods.name: rec_wav
methods.description: Initializes WAV header and calls record_file to capture audio.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Program entry point, processes command line argument and starts recording.
